## Implementation Plan: Persona 5-Style Portfolio Website

A 15-task plan building a single-page portfolio with pure HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — no frameworks or build tools.

---

**1. Project Setup & Design Tokens**
Create the file structure, HTML skeleton, CSS custom properties (P5 palette: red/black/white/gold), typography tokens, and empty JS class stubs.

**2. Global Layout, Dividers & Typography**
CSS reset, base layout styles, diagonal section dividers via `clip-path`, and P5-style heading/body typography.

**3. Nav Bar**
Fixed top nav with hamburger menu, smooth scroll-spy for active link highlighting, full ARIA support, and focus trapping on mobile.

**4. Checkpoint — Nav Bar Complete**
Verify nav tests pass before continuing.

**5. Hero Section**
Full-viewport hero with staggered name/role reveal animation (≤1.5s), a CTA button, and decorative geometric shapes.

**6. About Section**
Two-column layout with an angled-frame profile image and bio text, collapsing to single column on mobile.

**7. Skills Section**
Animated progress bars that fill to a defined proficiency width on scroll, with gold end-cap accents and accessible `role="progressbar"` markup.

**8. Projects Section**
CSS Grid cards with geometric borders, hover elevation effect (≤200ms), staggered entrance animation, and external project links.

**9. Contact Section**
Form with inline validation, `aria-live` error messages, and proper touch targets — no backend needed.

**10. Checkpoint — All Sections Complete**
Verify all section tests pass before the animation pass.

**11. AnimationController & Scroll Animations**
`IntersectionObserver`-based entrance animations for all `.animate-ready` elements, with an instant-reveal fallback and `prefers-reduced-motion` support.

**12. Hero Animation Wiring**
Connect the hero name/role keyframe reveal to `DOMContentLoaded`.

**13. Responsiveness & Mobile Polish**
Breakpoints at 480px and 768px, single-column stacking, `≥44px` touch targets, and no horizontal overflow from 320px to 1440px+.

**14. Performance & Accessibility Hardening**
Lazy-loaded images, `font-display: swap`, `will-change` management, semantic HTML audit, and ARIA attribute verification. JS target: under 50KB.

**15. Final Checkpoint**
All tests pass, full integration verified.

---

Tasks marked `*` are optional property-based tests (10 total) that validate correctness guarantees like animation idempotency, touch target sizes, and horizontal overflow — useful for a polished MVP but skippable for a faster build.
